_about: ADS-B / Mode S aircraft decoder (1090 MHz) using the installed gr-adsb blocks, laid out like gr-adsb's own adsb_rx example: magnitude -> framer -> demod -> decoder. Each aircraft update (ICAO address, callsign, altitude, speed, heading, position) becomes a decoded record: the job summary's 'decoded' table and the dashboard's Decoded view. gr-adsb needs exactly 2 MS/s; the resampler converts whatever rate the radio runs at (tune with sample_rate=2e6 to skip it).

blocks.name: src
blocks.note: live IQ - tune the radio to 1090 MHz first

blocks.name: rs
blocks.note: gr-adsb works at exactly 2 MS/s (ratio 1.0 = pass-through)

blocks.name: framer
blocks.note: finds the Mode S preamble; raise threshold if it triggers on noise

blocks.name: dec
blocks.note: CRC check + decode; each aircraft update goes to the data sink

blocks.name: null
blocks.note: the demod's sample output isn't needed

blocks.name: out
blocks.note: aircraft -> SPDATA records (job summary 'decoded' + dashboard Decoded view table)

use_when: decoding aircraft ADS-B / Mode S transponders at 1090 MHz (callsigns, altitude, positions)

variables_help.adsb_fs: rate gr-adsb runs at - leave at 2e6
variables_help.threshold: framer detection threshold on |IQ|^2 (0.01 default; raise if noise triggers it, lower for weak planes)
